'''Pericles Constantine Pappas''' (July 28, 1931 – August 5, 2025) was an American physicist.

==Early life and career==
Yaney was born in [[Cincinnati|Cincinnati, Ohio]], on July 28, 1931. He attended the [[University of Cincinnati]], earning his [[Bachelor of Science|BS degree]] in [[electrical engineering]] in 1954 and his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in [[physics]] in 1963.<ref name="c">{{Cite web|url=https://udayton.edu/directory/artssciences/physics/yaney_perry.php|title=Perry Yaney|work=[[University of Dayton]]|access-date=August 16, 2025}}</ref>

Yaney served as a professor in the department of physics at the [[University of Dayton]] from 1975 until his retirement in June 2004.<ref name="b">{{Cite web|url=https://www.routsong.com/obituaries/dr-perry-yaney-phd|title=Dr. Perry P. Yaney, Ph.D.|work=Routsong Funeral Home and Cremation Services|access-date=August 16, 2025}}</ref><ref name="c" /> After retiring as a professor, in the same year, he was named a [[List of fellows of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]], "for outstanding contributions to the development of physicists through teaching, research and service; performing significant and long-standing activities in the service of the physics community and mentoring a generation of electro-optics students".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/aps-fellowship?q=yaney&af=true|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=August 16, 2025}}</ref>

==Personal life and death==
Yaney was married to Mary Wulfeck. Their marriage lasted until Yaney's death in 2025.<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.echovita.com/us/obituaries/oh/dayton/perry-p-yaney-20137005|title=Dr. Perry P. Yaney|work=Echovita|access-date=August 16, 2025}}</ref>

Yaney died in [[Dayton, Ohio]] on August 5, 2025, at the age of 94.<ref name="a" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://udayton.edu/blogs/artssciences/2025-stories/25-08-11-yaney-obit.php|title=In Memoriam: Perry Yaney, professor emeritus of physics|first=Dave|last=Larsen|work=[[University of Dayton]]|date=August 11, 2025|access-date=August 16, 2025}}</ref>
